race.description: Bendigo Cup Packages On Sale Now Hcp (Bm66)
race.comment: Wary of LAWBOROUGH (3), a talented gelding who tackled a tougher race at his last run on April 25 and finished eighth behind Tycoon Star over 1200m in the G2 Tobin Bronze Stakes at Morphettville. He won his first two career starts and will kick up from the inside. Keeping safe. PURE PASSION (14) ran quite well fresh, finishing third over 1000m at Sale. Has always shown ability and is worth consideration here. ALERO (1) resumes and must be respected if he can recapture some of the good performances we saw during the last campaign. DELICATE LADY (2) hasn't shown much in recent efforts but is in the mix on best.
